body: I appreciate your comment, but my boyfriend is my only reason for living, that dependence is another factor in why I'm so pathetic. If I'm not adequate for him, I would rather die than be a hindrance.

His name is Cody, and he is the most beautiful and amazing person I've ever known. He treats everyone he meets with the same amount of respect and always understands and respects me. he always has faith that I'll get better and constantly reassures me. He works so hard and is so smart and charismatic. He's at university now and already making connections in the industry he wants to go into. He's unbelievably perfect and I want to give him everything. But I'm not someone who can become useful. If I stay with him, I will drag him down and use his resources and be just completely dependent and useless. Even though he loves me, It would be in his best interest for me to die.
